newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Allenby takes one shot lead at Masters.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Allenby takes one shot lead at Masters.

text.p: Australian Robert Allenby has taken a one-shot lead over compatriot Lucas Parsons, American Tiger Woods and Candada's Rick Gibson at the Australian Masters at Huntingdale.
Allenby birdied the par five 14th to move to ten under after picking up seven shots in his second round.
Woods also birdied the 14th for a share of second place with Parsons and Gibson, who has played 13 holes.
Parsons equalled the course record with a brilliant 64 on Thursday and has yet to tee off.
Australian Peter O'Malley, who has just started his second round, is on eight under par alongside compatriot Peter Lonard.
